scope_change: User now requests a coherent full-system development app. Replace the old singleton-only delivery limit in AGENTS/GOAL/BACKLOG while preserving authorization, version/evidence binding, idempotency, audit, explicit mock and no live fallback.
architecture: One modular monolith with PostgreSQL, one frontend, local development sessions, shared patient/encounter context, domain services and versioned contracts. Shared UI primitives are allowed; one generic JSON form is not an implementation of all domains.

levels.L0: Inventory/planning only; domain status and description.
levels.L1: Navigable UI or read-only fixtures without domain transactions.
levels.L2: Domain-specific list/detail/forms plus actual PostgreSQL workflow, authorized state transitions, validation, audit and meaningful tests; survives reload/restart.
levels.L3: Selected cross-module journeys preserve identities, relationships, versions, transaction semantics and authorization, with executed integration/browser evidence.
levels.L4: A named real external connector verified against its actual endpoint/artifact/protocol with authorization and execution evidence; separate from L2/L3 and not claimed here.

completion_policy.all_domains_minimum: All 38 must satisfy L2 before calling the minimum full-system development prototype complete. Do not substitute placeholders, fake success, localStorage-only data or isolated JSON forms.
completion_policy.coherence_gate: Execute the canonical J01–J10 from FULL_SYSTEM_SPEC_TH.md. Domain-specific L2 is required for every domain; L3 applies to these selected cross-module journeys. Unfinished work remains INCOMPLETE/NOT_RUN.
completion_policy.production_limit: L2/L3 means a functioning development prototype, not production certification, clinical effectiveness, complete national/payer standards or every feature of a hospital domain.
completion_policy.evidence: Per domain record actual UI/API/DB/migration/test locations and commands/results. Fields in this matrix are specifications; implementation and acceptance start NOT_IMPLEMENTED/NOT_RUN.
completion_policy.external_limit: Unknown external endpoints/credentials block only the named L4 connector. Local manual/export/synthetic-adapter workflows must still work and show actual connection status.

shared_foundation: Organization/Site/Department and user-role-scope model; real local sessions, server checks and portal ownership.
Patient identifiers, Encounter, Task with persisted domain/record/version binding; support many patients, visits and tasks without reset.
PostgreSQL foreign keys/unique/check constraints, transactional business services, optimistic versions/idempotency; no trusted IDs solely from browser context.
DocumentVersion/StorageObject with content hash, immutable attestations/amendments, AuditEvent and operation correlation IDs.
Decimal amount/currency and price snapshots; distinct billed/submitted/approved/gross_received/refunded/net_received/outstanding/cost; immutable posted ledger and stock movements.
Versioned OpenAPI/DTOs and migration/reconciliation plan; preserve old tested behavior or explicitly version breaking changes.
Synthetic multi-entity seeds with source/license/generator manifests; patient/document/model inputs remain untrusted data.
common_L2_acceptance: List/search/detail/domain-specific form and valid state transitions execute against the backend and PostgreSQL.
Reload/restart preserves state; create a second patient/encounter/task or non-patient business record without resetting prior evidence.
Wrong role/scope, stale version, invalid transition and duplicate command are rejected without partial writes; accepted actions create audit.
Meaningful domain tests plus browser interaction evidence where available; build/fixtures alone do not prove behavior.
No unvalidated dose, triage, blood-compatibility or diagnosis automation; clinical values and approvals are manual/synthetic for this prototype.

status_field_definitions.implementation_status: PLANNED/IN_PROGRESS/IMPLEMENTED for the new PostgreSQL domain workflow; independent of test results.
status_field_definitions.verified_level: Highest L0–L4 actually evidenced. Current domain pages are L0 scope placeholders; the separate old shared-core demo does not raise every domain to L2.
status_field_definitions.verification_status: NOT_RUN/PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED with per-check evidence; this specification does not execute the new targets.
status_field_definitions.external_integration_status: NOT_CONNECTED/STUB_ONLY/VERIFIED_EXTERNAL, scoped to a named connector and actual endpoint evidence. Local workflows can pass while external status remains NOT_CONNECTED.
